# Game testing

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-compatibility-docs.mjs. Edit data/game-compatibility.json. -->

Status recorded on **8 November 2026**. Open [Game compatibility](https://scummweb.tsilva.eu/compatibility)
to search these results, inspect checked editions, and visit recognized game pages.
Select **Compatibility** in the navigation or footer to open the page.

| Status | Games | Editions |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| [Tested: startup verified](#tested-startup-verified) | 249 | 265 |
| [Startup with warnings](#startup-with-warnings) | 8 | 8 |
| [Startup failed](#startup-failed) | 0 | 0 |
| [Not yet tested](#not-yet-tested) | 384 | — |

**Tested** means an edition reached a startup screen, menu, original game prompt,
or first game scene. Original game prompts count as successful startup checks.
It does not establish full-game compatibility or confirm every feature.
Warnings describe ScummVM or ScummWEB support limitations or workarounds.
Failures are ScummVM or ScummWEB issues that prevented startup. Problems caused
by missing, corrupt, or mismatched game files are excluded from public results,
including earlier checks. Results apply to the listed editions; they do not
guarantee the same behavior for every release or copy. Games can have
editions in more than one status; 273 editions have been checked.
The [compatibility data](../data/game-compatibility.json) is the source of truth
for this document and the compatibility page, including all checked editions.

## Tested: startup verified

Each checked edition has its own entry. Platform and edition variants are listed separately.
Road and the ScummC edition of Open Quest are fan games that launch under the Day of the Tentacle target. Passport to Adventure is a demo compilation.

## Not yet tested

These games have no recorded ScummWEB test result. Ratings come from the
[ScummVM 2026.4.0 compatibility chart](https://www.scummvm.org/compatibility/2026.4.0/).
Upstream ratings do not establish ScummWEB compatibility. Some engines are not included in ScummWEB.

The untested list includes Excellent, Good, and Bugged upstream ratings for game IDs without a checked edition. Ports and remakes with separate game IDs retain separate results, as do sequels, annual releases, and episodic parts. The upstream chart groups some supported games instead of listing each title individually.
